trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc is a staging build, so I didn't use either.
- **Rollback result:** all three regions now report v2.3.0. I didn't re-check the service status after the rollback, so I can't yet confirm that health checks and the error rate have recovered (the error rate was 0.18 before the rollback).
- **Incident:** the first attempt to create INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the retry returned one open incident, so it should not have paged twice. The description covers the rollback and the follow-ups: confirm recovery on v2.3.0 and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing.
